mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpRqDoosanStockCodeInsPopList*/ SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, ITEM_NO FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND (BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_buyer_item_no}||'%') OR ITEM_NO LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_buyer_item_no}||'%')) AND STATUS <> 'D'
mapper.update: UPDATE ICOMCQDT /*updateDoosanStockCode*/ SET ITEM_NO = #{st_stock_code}, STATUS = 'R', CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{BUYER_ITEM_NO} AND STATUS <> 'D'
